_comment: Curated publish titles (YouTube title + thumbnail header) per course, keyed by course id. Search-first: what someone would actually type, never 'Course 4'. One entry per course in src/content/index.ts.
why-python: Why Python? What It Is, Where It Came From, and What It Is Good At
how-python-runs: How Python Runs Your Code: Bytecode, the Call Stack, Memory and the GIL
start: Start a Python Project the Right Way: Virtual Environments, main.py, the REPL and Your First Errors
hold: Python Data Types for Beginners: Numbers, Decimal for Money, Strings, Lists, Tuples, Dicts and Sets
process: Python Control Flow and Functions: if, match, for and while Loops, Comprehensions and Exceptions
extract: Reading Files in Python: open and with, Encodings, pathlib, CSV, JSON, Validation and Generators
aggregate: Python Data Aggregation: Grouping, Counter, Sorting, Statistics, Dates and itertools
load: Writing Data in Python: CSV Reports, f-strings, JSON, SQLite Transactions and Safe Re-runs
